project: FL-1 calibration / self-test board Rev A
source: compiled from elec/src/*.ato (atopile) — same stack as pcba-rev-a

rows_top: TP09–TP16 at y=35 mm, same x spacing (row 2)
TP17–TP23 at y=55 mm, x=10..70 mm (row 3)
passives: Precision resistors R10/R1K/R100K between rows 1-2 near their pad pairs
Diodes D_SI/D_SCH between rows 2-3 near TP10-TP13
R_LED + LED between rows 2-3 near TP14-TP15
R_RC + C_RC between rows 2-3 near TP16-TP17
corner_bottom_right: EEPROM U1 (SOT-23-6) with decoupling cap + I2C pull-ups near TP18-TP21

analog_refs_note: All reference elements are passive; no analog island moat required. Keep GND plane continuous on In1. Short reference TP02-TP03 trace runs directly between pads (<5 mm, wide copper).
probe_pad_note: TestPoint:TestPoint_Pad_D2.0mm pads on F.Cu only; 2.5 mm solder-mask opening; no via. Pad pitch 10 mm to match FL-1 pogo cluster 60x50 mm footprint. Label each pad on F.Silkscreen with TP number and net name.
board_size_note: 90x80 mm fits inside FL-1 fixture (450x350 mm reachable). Stay well within 100x100 mm mechanical spec.
